channel.title: Andrew Brogdon · Blog & Media
channel.description: Technical essays, architecture deep dives, talks, and podcasts on generative UI, agentic workflows, and developer platforms by Andrew Brogdon.

item.title: A2UI 0.9.0 and GenUI
item.description: Exploring the latest updates to the A2UI protocol and Flutter's genui package, covering architectural shifts and the new prompt-first approach.

item.title: Very Good Engineering Podcast
item.description: Joining the Very Good Ventures team to discuss hyper-personalization, generative UI, and developer relations in the agentic era.

item.title: Speeding up generative UI with async A2UI
item.description: How to tackle cold-start latency in generative UI apps. Explores pre-generating, streaming, and caching A2UI messages using the Commis kitchen assistant as a case study.

item.title: Learning faster with Antigravity
item.description: Creating Flutter frontends for Python-based ADK agents using a structured 5-step learning loop with Google Antigravity.

item.title: Flutter + A2UI = GenUI
item.description: Introducing A2UI, an open protocol for Generative UI that enables autonomous AI agents to dynamically negotiate and render Flutter interfaces.

item.title: Introducing the Full-stack developer guide (Flutter, Firebase, Angular)
item.description: Announcing a joint guide from the Flutter, Firebase, and Angular teams demonstrating how to architect and build full-stack, multiplatform apps.

item.title: New updates to A2UI and Flutter’s GenUI package
item.description: Key architectural changes to the genui package, showing how the A2UI protocol bridges autonomous AI agents with client-side Flutter widget catalogs.

item.title: Generative UI Deep Dive
item.description: Presented with Yegor Jbanov at Google Cloud Next '26 on moving beyond text-only chatbots by enabling autonomous AI agents to dynamically negotiate and render rich client UIs.

item.title: Build to Succeed: Developer Relations in the Agentic Era
item.description: Discussing the changing landscape of developer advocacy, agentic software workflows, and why storytelling matters in engineering.

item.title: Agentic apps, part 2 | Observable Flutter #60
item.description: Joining Craig Labenz on Observable Flutter to live-code an agentic experience using Flutter and the Gemini Colorist codelab.

item.title: Agentic apps with Flutter | Observable Flutter #59
item.description: Exploring AI-powered, agentic app concepts and architecture on Observable Flutter with Craig Labenz.

item.title: Build agentic apps in Flutter and Angular
item.description: Teaming up with Mark Thompson to introduce cross-framework resources from Angular, Flutter, and Firebase for agentic user experiences.

item.title: Live Coding with Rivers Cuomo
item.description: Co-hosting a live programming session with Weezer singer/songwriter Rivers Cuomo, hacking on Flutter and Python developer tools.

item.title: Fluttercon Berlin Opening Keynote
item.description: Opening address at Fluttercon Berlin covering Flutter's multiplatform trajectory, developer productivity, and ecosystem evolution.

item.title: CodePen Radio #265: Flutter on CodePen
item.description: Joining Chris Coyier and Alex Vazquez to explore embedding Flutter compilation and live web runtimes into CodePen.
